title: 倫敦伊莉莎白線~London Elizabeth line
focus: 都市穿越線多介面控制與地下車站~Urban cross-city control interfaces and underground stations
summary: 以倫敦伊莉莎白線連接既有鐵路與新建中央隧道的情境為背景，建立多運轉區段的教學案例。課程把定位、通訊、車門及轉乘人流串成事件鏈，要求先證明每個邊界的允許狀態，再討論端到端班距與乘客便利。~Use the Elizabeth line’s connection of existing railways through a new central tunnel as the setting for a multi-section teaching case. Link localisation, communication, doors and interchange flows in an event chain. Establish permissible states at each boundary before discussing end-to-end headway or passenger convenience, and explicitly distinguish test readiness from the commencement of revenue service.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 sigma=1.808863 m；單元 2 得 stale_distance=7.95 m；單元 3 得 transition=366.1538 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 s1 的擾動測試，結果改為 1.838127 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以倫敦伊莉莎白線連接既有鐵路與新建中央隧道的情境為背景，建立多運轉區段的教學案例。課程把定位、通訊、車門及轉乘人流串成事件鏈，要求先證明每個邊界的允許狀態，再討論端到端班距與乘客便利。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives sigma=1.808863 m; unit 2 gives stale_distance=7.95 m; unit 3 gives transition=366.1538 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing s1 in the first unit changes its result to 1.838127 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Elizabeth line’s connection of existing railways through a new central tunnel as the setting for a multi-section teaching case. Link localisation, communication, doors and interchange flows in an event chain. Establish permissible states at each boundary before discussing end-to-end headway or passenger convenience, and explicitly distinguish test readiness from the commencement of revenue service. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2021 年：伊莉莎白線開始試運轉並進入試營運階段；2022 年：伊莉莎白線中央區段於五月開放旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以倫敦伊莉莎白線連接既有鐵路與新建中央隧道的情境為背景，建立多運轉區段的教學案例。課程把定位、通訊、車門及轉乘人流串成事件鏈，要求先證明每個邊界的允許狀態，再討論端到端班距與乘客便利。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2021: The Elizabeth line began trial running and progressed into trial operations; 2022: The Elizabeth line central section opened to passengers in May. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Elizabeth line’s connection of existing railways through a new central tunnel as the setting for a multi-section teaching case. Link localisation, communication, doors and interchange flows in an event chain. Establish permissible states at each boundary before discussing end-to-end headway or passenger convenience, and explicitly distinguish test readiness from the commencement of revenue service. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.title: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 在中央隧道與地面接續處追蹤位置誤差包絡。~Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Track the position-error envelope at the connection between central tunnel and surface sections.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.24 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.808863 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.664 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.838127 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.24 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.808863 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.664 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.838127 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。~Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion.
units.failure: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。~A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.
units.misconception: 兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差~Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
units.practice: 建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.mechanism: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 對每次運轉模式轉換記錄封包年齡與授權狀態。~A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Record packet age and authority state for every operating-mode transition.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.318 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.95 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3498 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.745 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.318 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.95 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3498 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.745 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.
units.verify: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。~Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.
units.failure: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。~Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.
units.misconception: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達~A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
units.practice: 把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.mechanism: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 用相同距離基準檢查目標速度和保護曲線的關係。~Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Use a common distance reference to compare target speed with the protective curve.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=24 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=366.1538 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 26.4 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 459.2 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=24 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=366.1538 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 26.4 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 459.2 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded.
units.verify: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。~Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front.
units.failure: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。~A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies.
units.misconception: 降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差~Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
units.practice: 對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.mechanism: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。多個獨立誤差可用平方和開根號描述標準差，但系統偏差須另加；幾何對位也不能代替障礙物偵測和關門互鎖。 停車、測量與門位置三個獨立零均值誤差以變異數相加，再取平方根得到合成標準差。這不是最大偏移保證，也不含共同系統偏差；機械淨空及容許對位範圍須另外核對。 分開停準、車門位置與測量誤差，核對平台對位的合成標準差。~Train-to-platform door alignment combines stopping position, door spacing and control tolerances. Independent random errors can be combined by root-sum-square, but systematic offsets must be added separately. Geometric alignment does not replace obstruction detection or the door-closure interlock. Three independent zero-mean errors in stopping, surveying and door position combine through summed variances. The square root gives a standard deviation, not a guaranteed maximum offset. Shared bias is excluded, and mechanical clearance and permitted alignment ranges require separate checks. Separate stopping, door-position and survey errors when checking combined alignment standard deviation.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0848 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08840837 m。敏感度：stop_sigma 單獨增加百分之十至 0.09328 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.09657204 m。模型邊界：獨立零均值誤差；不是最大誤差界限，也未給允收公差。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: stop_sigma=0.0848 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m; calculation: combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08840837 m. Sensitivity: stop_sigma, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.09328 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.09657204 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean errors; not a maximum bound and no acceptance tolerance is specified.
units.verify: 以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。 以獨立基準重複量測停準與門位，檢查各誤差平均值、相關性和單位，再核對合成分布。~Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Repeat stopping and door-position measurements against an independent reference, check each mean, correlation and unit, and compare the combined distribution.
units.failure: 定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 若共同定位偏差存在，平方和模型會低估實際對位偏移。~Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A shared positioning bias makes the root-sum-square model understate actual alignment offset.
units.misconception: 停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移~A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
units.practice: 把隨機誤差和固定偏移分開做誤差預算，畫出不同載重的停準分布，列出對位與互鎖需分別驗證的證據。 再以本單元 stop_sigma 的對照值重算 combined_sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build separate random-error and fixed-bias budgets, plot stopping distributions at different loads, and list distinct evidence for alignment and interlocking. Also recalculate combined_sigma for the alternative stop_sigma value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.title: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.mechanism: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 檢查長月台上旅客分布不均如何影響最慢門組。~Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Inspect how uneven distribution along a long platform affects the slowest door group.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=254 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.22917 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 280至 280 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.58333 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=254 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.22917 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 280, to 280 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.58333 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。~Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation.
units.failure: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。~Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery.
units.misconception: 每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異~Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
units.practice: 將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.mechanism: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 以轉乘批次到達比較平均密度與局部通道壅塞。~Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Compare mean density with local passage congestion under interchange batch arrivals.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=445 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.271429 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 490至 490 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.4 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=445 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.271429 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 490, to 490 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.4 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.
units.verify: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。~Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously.
units.failure: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。~A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.
units.misconception: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞~Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
units.practice: 模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.mechanism: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 分開隧道活塞風和車站一般換氣的量測邊界。~A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Separate measurement boundaries for tunnel piston airflow and normal station ventilation.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=26.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=260.67 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 29.15 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 236.9727 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=26.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=260.67 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 29.15 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 236.9727 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded.
units.verify: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。~Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Check the time constant with safe tracer decay, measure concentration at multiple points, retain door states, and check for a continuing source.
units.failure: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。~Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A running fan does not prove effective dilution; inspect bypass and continuing contaminant sources.
units.misconception: 風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降~A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
units.practice: 對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.mechanism: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 把電扶梯與深層步行連通道分開計算轉乘時間。~A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Calculate transfer time separately for escalators and deep-level walking connections.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=190.8 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=64.2 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 209.88 m，其餘固定，結果為 45.12 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=190.8 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=64.2 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 209.88 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 45.12 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。~Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.
units.failure: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。~Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.
units.misconception: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接~The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
units.practice: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 在接續區段以進路狀態表確認衝突移動不能同時授權。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Use a route-state table to confirm conflicting movements cannot receive simultaneous authority.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=8 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=256 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 9 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 512 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=8 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=256 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 9 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 512 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.title: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.mechanism: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 區分中央區段設備可用性與整條跨城服務的可用性。~In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Distinguish central-section equipment availability from availability of the complete cross-city service.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1272 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968652 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1399.2 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9971494 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1272 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968652 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1399.2 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9971494 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.
units.verify: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。~Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.
units.failure: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。~Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.
units.misconception: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低~High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
units.practice: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

教學假設，單元 2：latency=0.318 s，計算 stale_distance=7.95 m；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 2: latency=0.318 s, calculated stale_distance=7.95 m; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 3：initial=24 m/s，計算 transition=366.1538 m；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: initial=24 m/s, calculated transition=366.1538 m; not measured performance.
